probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A method, comprising: inputting __a plurality of__ database constructs generated by a database optimizer as an input to a trained machine-learning algorithm; obtaining a database operation predictor from the machine-learning algorithm as an output; modifying at least one of the database constructs based on the database operation predictor producing a modified database construct; and processing a database operation with the __plurality of__ database constructs and the modified database construct.

(Currently Amended) Claim 2: The method of claim 1, wherein inputting further includes inputting the database constructs as query execution plans for __at least one__ query.

(Currently Amended) Claim 3: The method of claim 2, wherein inputting further includes identifying at least one database construct as a least cost query execution plan identified from the query execution plans by the database optimizer, the least cost query execution plan being determined based on __a comparison of execution costs__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 5: The method of claim 1, wherein obtaining further includes acquiring the database operation predictor as an estimated Central Processing Unit (CPU) execution time for __at least one__ Access Module Processor to execute when processing the database operation.

(Currently Amended) Claim 6: The method of claim 1, wherein obtaining further includes acquiring the database operation predictor as an estimated number of Input/Output (I/O) operations performed by __at least one__ Access Module Processor during execution when processing the database operation.

(Currently Amended) Claim 10: The method of claim 1 further comprising, storing the database operation predictor in database statistics associated with the database operation and __the plurality of__ database constructs.

(Currently Amended) Claim 12: A method comprising: training a machine-learning algorithm with __a set of__ database constructs produced by a database optimizer; receiving query execution plans for __at least one__ query from the database optimizer with a least cost query execution plan identified by the database optimizer for the query; providing the query execution plans as input to the machine-learning algorithm; obtaining as an output a predicted execution time for the query based on the least cost query execution plan; and modifying one of: the least cost query execution plan for the query, a scheduled execution time for the query, and resources that are used to execute the query based on the predicted execution time.

(Currently Amended) Claim 15: The method of claim 12, wherein providing further includes providing the database tool within a workload scheduler and management component of a database system, the database tool being configured to __analyze and optimize__ query execution plans.

(Currently Amended) Claim 16: The method of claim 12, wherein training further includes training the machine-learning algorithm as a linear regression-based machine-learning algorithm, the training process being based on __historical execution data__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 18: The method of claim 12, wherein modifying further includes changing an execution resource of the least cost query execution plan based on the predicted query execution time and a current performance associated with the execution resource, the current performance being determined from __real-time monitoring__ of the execution resource. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 19: A system, comprising: a database management system; at least one hardware processor; a non-transitory computer-readable storage medium having executable instructions representing a trained machine-learning algorithm; the machine learning algorithm configured to execute on the at least one hardware processor from the non-transitory computer-readable storage medium and to perform processing to: i) receive as input __a set of__ database constructs produced by a database optimizer for a database operation of the database management system; and ii) provide as output a predicted value relevant to one of: one or more of the database constructs and the database operation; wherein the database management system is configured to process the predicted value to determine whether to modify one of: the one or more database constructs and the database operation before processing the database operation within the database management system.

(Currently Amended) Claim 20: The system of claim 19, wherein the predicted value is an estimated query execution time for a query and the database operation is execution of a query execution plan for the query within the database management system, the estimated query execution time being based on __a comparison with historical execution times__.
